name: validate_dyn_file
author: hprebar
title: Validate DYN file
description: Inspect and validate a Dynamo graph (.dyn) JSON structure and node schema without executing it. Checks JSON syntax, node types, unresolved packages, and cyclic connections. Read-only.
notes: Validates graph JSON schema and dependencies. Can inspect active workspace or parse raw fileContent JSON passed in arguments.

fileContent.description: Raw JSON text content of the .dyn graph file to validate

filePath.description: Optional file path of the .dyn graph. If fileContent is omitted and the graph is loaded in workspace, validates active workspace matching this path.

checkPackages.description: Whether to check package dependency declarations against loaded packages in Dynamo
